name: Group
description: AI squads, faction groups, playable groups, and team definitions
postCreateNotes: Set the faction key (US, USSR, FIA, or custom) in the group entity's own m_faction (not a component), as vanilla Prefabs/Groups/BLUFOR/Group_US_Base.et does; it is not pre-written, since an empty m_faction would override a parent's faction
Callsigns come from SCR_CallsignGroupComponent (inherited from PlayableGroup.et), which holds no settable callsign attribute
Set up group composition (squad leader + members)
Define AI behavior and skill levels
Set formation and movement preferences if applicable
